verdicts.reason: Both break the price-card group apart. The three cards shrink to illegible thumbnails, the city names and 'from' text are microscopic, and the cards are scattered down the centre axis. In both, the subhead sits far above its headline, hangs off a separate left edge and leaves large dead gaps. A puts a card above the logo, but it keeps the cards in price order (89/119/139) and has a strong CTA. B puts the logo first, but it shuffles the cards (119, 139, then 89 below the CTA) and shrinks the CTA, so it is slightly worse.
